seriesTitle: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny

episodes.title: Enter the Dragon Master
episodes.summary: After absorbing the mystical Hero Chi of the Four Constellations, four panda kids enlist the Dragon Master to teach them Kung Fu.

episodes.title: Blue Dragon Plays with Fire
episodes.summary: When the kids grow over-confident after beginning their training, they decide to intercept a distress call and sneak off without permission, only to land themselves in hot water.

episodes.title: Blade of the Red Phoenix
episodes.summary: Po and the kids are recruited to perform in Mei Mei's theatrical show, but things take a turn when Jindiao ruins the play in order to find a mystical scroll.

episodes.title: The Intruder Flies a Crooked Path
episodes.summary: When Jindiao arrives to the Village, he invites the kids to participate in an exhibition match, but has alternative motives.

episodes.title: A Fistful of Herbs
episodes.summary: When Po discovers he was poisoned, he sets off to a caravan oasis in the hopes of finding out who the perpetrator is, unknowingly followed by the kids.

episodes.title: Poison in the Pit of the Plum
episodes.summary: When Po and the kids stop for the night at an Inn, they meet a gang who wants to fight Po and end up down a path to uncovering Jindiao's evil plan.

episodes.title: Big Trouble in Panda Village
episodes.summary: The kids must leave Po to escape into the forest and head back to Panda Village to prepare against Jindiao.

episodes.title: Secrets Lost to Shadow
episodes.summary: The kids meet an unlikely ally when trying to find Po.

episodes.title: Out of the Cave and Onto Thin Ice
episodes.summary: After a shocking revelation, Po is determined to get his chi back and Jing decides to face Jindiao.

episodes.title: Return of the Four Constellations
episodes.summary: The kids go to the Spirit Realm and meet the Original Four Constellations in the hopes of learning how to defeat Jindiao.

episodes.title: Unholy Dragon Returns to the Mountains
episodes.summary: Jindiao takes Po and the kids hostage in an attempt to locate the Wellspring.

episodes.title: Sacrifice at the Edge of Time
episodes.summary: The kids are desperate to get back and help their fellow Panda Villagers, and Po decides he must figure out a way to defeat Jindiao before he controls the world.

episodes.title: End of the Dragon Master
episodes.summary: Po, the kids, and the new Panda Guardians must work together to defeat Jindiao once and for all, and get a visit from an unlikely source.

episodes.title: Journey to the East
episodes.summary: Feeling a little bored with their new hero life, Po and the kids are excited to accept an important invitation to the Forbidden City. Meanwhile, there's a curious disturbance deep in Panda Village...

episodes.title: Curse of the Monkey King
episodes.summary: Po and the Kids take a shortcut to the boat bound for the Forbidden City, and are waylaid by a tricky monkey. Zhizhu informs Mayor Li of some distressing sounds coming from the Wellspring.

episodes.title: A Game of Fists
episodes.summary: When Po and eventually the kids finally make it on the Riverboat, they discover old friends, new enemies, and perplexing cargo.

episodes.title: The Beast of the Wasteland
episodes.summary: Po and the Kids are once more waylaid, this time by Mole Rats who have deemed Bao their god. But when Bao isn't able to defeat the mythical creature plaguing the Wasteland, Fan Tong steps up to save the day.

episodes.title: Danger in the Forbidden City
episodes.summary: Po and the Kids finally arrive in the Forbidden City. After an assassination scare, Xiao enlists Po and the Four Constellations for help protecting her during her father's funeral.

episodes.title: The Battle(s) of Gongmen Bay
episodes.summary: Po and the Kids agree to escort a dirigible shipment of food to a drought-torn region of China. But Nu Hai has some suspicions about Shi Long, which she finds aren't far off when she discovers the dirigible is set to explode...with them on board!

episodes.title: Gongmen City Hustle
episodes.summary: Po and the Kids make it to Gongmen City in search of the contact they heard has some info on the dirigible crash. Meanwhile, Xiao, mourning the presumed death of her new panda friends, takes off into the woods and meets a new friend.

episodes.title: Night of the White Bone Demon
episodes.summary: In a giant sea battle, Po and the Kids manage to escape the pursuing police to make it to Volcano island and get some answers. Empress Xiao begins learning how to defend herself.

episodes.title: Rise of the Empress
episodes.summary: On the Volcano Island, Po and the Kids are reunited with Li, Grandma, Ping, Rooster, Wing, and Wong, and work together to find out what's really going on the island. Xiao becomes suspicious of some of her royal workers.

episodes.title: Bridge Over Troubled Lava
episodes.summary: The whole gang escapes pursing Guards, battles flowing lava, and survives crumbling caves and pillars to finally make it back to the Forbidden City. Xiao is ready to escape the palace, but Shi Long has other plans for her.

episodes.title: House of Flying Pandas
episodes.summary: The gang learns of even bigger and direr forces working against the Empress and the Kingdom of China, and must come up with a plan to put a stop to it before it is too late.

episodes.title: Coronation of the Iron Goddess
episodes.summary: When things don't quite go according to plan, Po and the Kids must rally with other allies to save the Empress and protect China.

episodes.title: The Invincible Armour
episodes.summary: Po and the Kids are put to the ultimate test, and must use all their knowledge and skills in order to defeat The White Bone Demon.
